name: Alphabet state creation and independent ruler visibility
covers: tap letter toggles its 75px ruler timeline
description: Verifies the compact alphabet-state flow and that timelines remain hidden until their letter is tapped.
steps: Enter ANIM mode
Verify only + State is visible
Tap + State and verify A appears with no ruler
Tap A to show its ruler
Tap A again to hide its ruler
expected: The sequence begins with only + State, creates A on demand, and toggles a 75px ruler inside the 80px glass panel.

name: Transform gizmo snapping and precision modifiers
covers: snap toggle remains respected after key release
description: Verifies the transform gizmo supports normal snapping and reduced snap increments while Shift is held.
steps: Create and select a mesh
Enable snapping and drag the move gizmo
Hold Shift while dragging the move gizmo
Release Shift and disable snapping
Hold Ctrl while dragging a gizmo and release Ctrl
expected: Translation uses 0.5 units, rotation 15 degrees and scale 0.1 normally; Shift reduces the increments to one tenth, one third and one half respectively, while Ctrl temporarily enables snapping.

name: Alphabet handle resizes the preceding timeline
description: Verifies the alphabet letter acts as the drag handle for the preceding timeline and ruler markings remain visible.
steps: Enter ANIM mode and add A
Show A's timeline
Add B and drag B to the right
Verify A's timeline expands and ruler labels include frame numbers
Drag B left and verify A's timeline stops at its minimum width
expected: Dragging B resizes A's track without a separate handle or configured maximum; ruler ticks, keyframe diamonds and playhead remain visible.

name: Playback controls stay hidden until Anim trigger
covers: bottom-left BACK PLAY/PAUSE FORWARD controls hidden by default
description: Verifies playback controls are opt-in and the editor can be exited without affecting the scene workspace.
steps: Enter ANIM mode
Verify playback controls are hidden
Tap Anim
Verify BACK, PLAY/PAUSE and FORWARD appear at bottom-left
Hide controls and exit Animation Mode
expected: Playback controls remain hidden by default, toggle from the right-center Anim trigger, and exiting animation returns to the normal editor.

name: Connected mesh edits and previously successful editor systems remain intact
covers: edge endpoints and adjacent faces move together
Face Mode selects an entire coplanar surface with perimeter-only highlight and a centered gizmo pivot
Extrude moves the selected face region
one-tap Subdivide reconstructs the original BoxGeometry corner order into square quads
every subdivided face remains a non-degenerate square quad across repeated taps
visible topology draws square perimeters only and never diagonal triangle cuts
quad-grid metadata survives Undo, Redo, and .nexus save/load
whole-mesh Smooth changes vertex positions after subdivision
subdivision wireframe and cut-loop overlays remain depth-tested, visible on exterior surfaces, and hidden behind opaque mesh surfaces
mobile-safe smoothing updates geometry without excessive synchronous work or freezing,
Loop Cut activates from the bottom icon, previews a pink drag line over the mesh, commits a black cut outline on release, and keeps the cut attached
UV seams and hard-edge attributes remain un-welded
Top Toolbar World Axis, Move, Rotate, Scale work during Vertex, Edge, and Face editing without Scene Tree reselection
loop-cut position slider regenerates a real cut from the original mesh and permits loop sliding
description: Guards the geometry integrity fix and previously successful Nexus3D editor systems against regression.
steps: Create and select a cube, then open Mesh Editing
Choose Vertex mode, select a corner, and drag it; inspect all adjacent faces for gaps
Choose Edge mode, drag an edge, and inspect both endpoints and neighboring faces
Switch between Vertex, Edge, and Face modes and confirm the mesh remains connected
While Face Mode is active, verify the highlight has no internal triangulation diagonals and the gizmo sits at the face center, then drag Move, Rotate, and Scale without Scene Tree reselection
Tap Subdivide once on a fresh Cube and inspect all six surfaces for complete square faces with no diagonal cuts or missing faces
Tap Subdivide two more times and verify every resulting face remains non-degenerate and square, then Undo and Redo the latest pass
Save the subdivided Cube as Project.nexus, reload it, and verify the square-grid overlay and face boundaries are restored
Tap Loop Cutting once on a cube and verify a centered cut appears, then move Loop Position toward each side and confirm the cut remains attached
Select a face, tap Loop Cut in the bottom toolbar, drag across the face while observing the pink preview, then release to commit the black topology cut
Select a face adjacent to the cut and drag it upward and downward with the Top Toolbar Move gizmo
Import a GLTF/GLB mesh and repeat a vertex or edge drag near a shared seam
Change object transforms, save Project.nexus, and reload the project
Toggle CAM then USER and open Skybox, Manual Bones, and Auto-IK
expected: Subdivide reconstructs the original BoxGeometry faces into valid square quads, repeated taps subdivide the current canonical quad layout without degenerate faces or visible diagonal cuts, the square perimeter overlay stays attached, and Undo/Redo plus .nexus save/load restore the correct quad-grid state; Loop Cut, Smooth, and the other existing editor systems remain available.

name: Loop Cut drag preview and controlled Subdivide cuts
covers: pink drag preview follows pointer across selected face
black committed cut outline after pointer release
repeated Subdivide taps create only valid square quad faces with no diagonal triangle cuts
all six cube surfaces remain complete with no invisible or missing faces
topology overlay remains attached to transformed mesh
description: Verifies the touch-first cut workflow and guards repeated subdivision against geometry explosion.
steps: Create and select a cube
Enter Face mode and tap a face
Tap Loop Cut in the bottom toolbar
Drag across the face and verify a pink preview follows the finger
Release and verify the cut becomes a black outline in the mesh
Tap Subdivide repeatedly and verify each tap adds a cut without freezing or crashing
Move the mesh and verify the cut lines stay attached
expected: The pink preview tracks the drag, pointer release commits a real black mesh cut, repeated Subdivide taps produce only valid square quad faces with no visible diagonal cuts or missing surfaces, and the editor remains responsive.

name: Face region selection, local extrusion, gizmo, and history
covers: independent selection of each subdivided square quad cell
extrusion affects only the tapped square cell with no neighboring face movement
Undo and Redo restore face geometry
description: Verifies that a subdivided planar face is edited by region rather than moving every coplanar triangle.
steps: Create a cube and enter Face editing mode
Subdivide the cube into square quad cells
Tap one square cell and verify only that exact cell highlights
Extrude the selected square and verify all neighboring cells and cube sides remain in place
Verify the transform gizmo is attached to the raised cap
Extrude the same cap again, then Undo and Redo
expected: Only the tapped square cell moves, its four perimeter side walls close cleanly, neighboring cells remain unchanged, the gizmo stays on the raised cap, and Undo/Redo restore the before and after geometry.
